title: Concurrent writes to same blob_id share a single .tmp path — data race
description: kith-attach/src/lib.rs:58,90 both write to '<id>.tmp'. If two concurrent writes for the same blob_id arrive (retransmit storm or collision), one write's data silently overwrites the other's .tmp mid-write. The final rename is atomic but the .tmp content is nondeterministic. Fix: use a per-write unique temp suffix (e.g. append a random token) so concurrent writes don't share a .tmp path.
